text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were unchanged from Tuesday's levels with shipowners still testing the waters although some expected prices to ease on good supplies, traders said on Wednesday.

Bunker 380-cst was indicated as low as $122.50 per tonne by a major with some quoting $125. Bunker 180-cst was heard between $128-$130 per tonne. A shipowner said he had no enquiries and would bunker in Fujiarah as prices were more competitive with 380-cst quoted under $120.
MDO and gas oil prices were lower at $238-$242 and $248-$255 per tonne respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
